##### <a name="-teamcity--agent_name"></a>`agent_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

Build agent name, displayed on the TeamCity server.

Default value: `$facts['networking']['hostname']`

##### <a name="-teamcity--agent_user"></a>`agent_user`

Data type: `String[1]`

User that runs the build agent.

Default value: `'teamcity'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--agent_user_home"></a>`agent_user_home`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::Absolutepath]`

Home directory of a managed user. Defaults to `agent_dir`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-teamcity--manage_agent_user_home"></a>`manage_agent_user_home`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to create the home directory of a managed user.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-teamcity--agent_group"></a>`agent_group`

Data type: `String[1]`

Group of the build agent user.

Default value: `'teamcity'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--manage_user"></a>`manage_user`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to create the build agent user.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-teamcity--manage_group"></a>`manage_group`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to create the build agent group.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-teamcity--server_url"></a>`server_url`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

Root URL of the TeamCity server, written to the agent config.

Default value: `'http://builder'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--archive_name"></a>`archive_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

Name of the agent archive on the server.

Default value: `'buildAgent.zip'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--download_url"></a>`download_url`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::HTTPUrl]`

URL of the agent archive. Defaults to `${server_url}/update/${archive_name}`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-teamcity--agent_dir"></a>`agent_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Installation directory of the build agent.

Default value: `'/opt/build-agent'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--service_ensure"></a>`service_ensure`

Data type: `Stdlib::Ensure::Service`

State of the build agent service.

Default value: `'running'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--service_enable"></a>`service_enable`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the build agent service starts at boot.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-teamcity--service_provider"></a>`service_provider`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Deprecated and ignored, the agent always runs as systemd service.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-teamcity--teamcity_agent_mem_opts"></a>`teamcity_agent_mem_opts`

Data type: `String`

Java options exported as `TEAMCITY_AGENT_MEM_OPTS`.

Default value: `'-Xms512m -Xmx1024m -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8'`

##### <a name="-teamcity--custom_properties"></a>`custom_properties`

Data type: `Hash`

Settings merged into `conf/buildAgent.properties`.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-teamcity--launcher_wrapper_conf"></a>`launcher_wrapper_conf`

Data type: `Hash`

Settings merged into `launcher/conf/wrapper.conf`.

Default value: `{}`
